system.description: A crab claw cyber implant replaces the user’s forearm and hand with an oversized, pneumatically driven cutting clamp. These serrated blades have a bite strength similar to the jaws of life by emergency responders. If the user wishes damage their opponent during a grapple (p. SR6 ), they deal this weapon’s DV + net hits rather than Strength/2. A crab claw doubles its DV when employed against a barrier that can be placed tween its blades.
